findings.motion: Senate floor third reading, SB 1174 (Min), passed 30-8-2
findings.note: SB 1174 bars local governments from requiring voter identification for elections. The bill page's vote list for the Senate floor vote of 2024-05-21 (30-8-2) names Ashby among the YES votes. The official leginfo page was blocked, so the vote list is from the CalMatters Digital Democracy bill page.
